LanguageData.Gun_CZ_75B_Full_Auto_RWP.label: CZ 75B Full Auto
LanguageData.Gun_CZ_75B_Full_Auto_RWP.description: A fully automatic variant of the CZ 75B pistol, this weapon combines the stopping power of a handgun with the rapid-fire capability of a submachine gun. It offers high reliability and accuracy, making it ideal for close-quarters combat scenarios. Its rate of fire allows for quick suppression of threats, although its smaller magazine requires frequent reloading.
